title: Single-Cell Multi-Omics Dissection of Malignant Evolutionary Mechanisms and Construction of a Prognostic Model for Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma
authors: Liu R; Shi Y; Xiao Y; Ren B; Li L; Qi B; Li T; Zhang Y; Gao J
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单细胞多组学解析肾透明细胞癌分级进展中的表观遗传与转录调控网络，虽涉及TF调控但核心是肿瘤预后建模，非TF-DNA互作机制研究，方法上以机器学习为主，与课题相关性中等。
abstract: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) exhibits pronounced heterogeneity across WHO histological grades, yet systematic single-cell multi-omics studies characterizing these transitions remain limited. We integrated scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq data across ccRCC WHO grades to establish a multi-omics framework encompassing tumor cells and immune populations. Using pseudotime trajectory analysis and machine learning ensembles, we developed a prognostic signature (CBG) from core nodes of transcriptional regulatory networks. We found that in tumor cells, epigenetic alterations consistently precede metabolic reprogramming and invasive adaptation. CD8 + T cell exhaustion followed a trajectory shifting from IRF7– to ZNF683-regulated states, while monocytes differentiated toward M1 and M2 macrophages orchestrated by NFIC/IL1B and CEBPD/GLI2. Intercellular communication networks showed a temporal progression from inflammation, through vascular remodeling, to immunosuppression dominance. The CBG signature demonstrated robust performance in independent cohorts, identifying SLC11A1 and SH3YL1 as antagonistic survival determinants. This study elucidates the dynamic molecular and immunological mechanisms underlying ccRCC grade progression, providing a robust framework for subtype-specific prognostication and precision therapeutic targeting.
abstract_zh: 透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）在WHO组织学分级中表现出显著异质性，然而系统性的单细胞多组学研究在表征这些转变方面仍有限。我们整合了跨ccRCC WHO分级的scRNA-seq和scATAC-seq数据，建立了一个涵盖肿瘤细胞和免疫细胞的多组学框架。利用伪时间轨迹分析和机器学习集成方法，我们从转录调控网络的核心节点开发了一种预后特征（CBG）。我们发现，在肿瘤细胞中，表观遗传改变始终先于代谢重编程和侵袭性适应。CD8+ T细胞耗竭遵循从IRF7–到ZNF683调控状态的转变轨迹，而单核细胞在NFIC/IL1B和CEBPD/GLI2的调控下分化为M1和M2巨噬细胞。细胞间通讯网络显示出从炎症，经血管重塑，到免疫抑制主导的时间进展。CBG特征在独立队列中表现出稳健性能，将SLC11A1和SH3YL1识别为拮抗性生存决定因素。本研究阐明了ccRCC分级进展背后的动态分子和免疫机制，为亚型特异性预后和精准治疗靶向提供了稳健框架。
